Class MeteorSwarm

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.MeteorSwarm
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class MeteorSwarm extends Card
Represents the Meteor Swarm event card that simulates a series of meteors hitting each player's ship.
